_comment: Example policy. Per client: copy to <install>/config/client/policy.json (install.sh does this and sets dashboardUrl), then edit. Auto-escalation policy (TG-016). An incident climbs one level per step while it stays TRIGGERED/ESCALATED (not acknowledged). Each step is an EscalateIncident transaction on the ledger.

levels.reason: Unacknowledged for 15 min — site safety officer alerted
High-risk incident unacknowledged for 4 h — regulator intimation due (Factories Act s.88)
